name: Fruit Warp

features.name: Fruit Mode
features.description: Five or more fruits activate it.

review:
A fruit game with no paylines. Land five or more of a fruit and Fruit Mode kicks in, with a dynamic multiplier that can push wins much higher.

Medium volatility and an 11,000x cap are a nice combination, and the 97.0% RTP is well above average. A modern take on fruit slots that pays back better than most of them.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
